objects.name: authority_ancestor_exit_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER authority_ancestor_exit_insert BEFORE INSERT ON authority
WHEN NEW.parent_authority_id IS NOT NULL
AND NEW.state NOT IN ('REVOKED','COMPLETED','REJECTED','ABORTED','FAILED')
AND EXISTS (
 WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(authority_id, parent_authority_id, issuer_kind, issuer_id, subject_kind, subject_id) AS (
  SELECT authority_id, parent_authority_id, issuer_kind, issuer_id, subject_kind, subject_id
  FROM authority WHERE authority_id = NEW.parent_authority_id
  UNION
  SELECT p.authority_id, p.parent_authority_id, p.issuer_kind, p.issuer_id, p.subject_kind, p.subject_id
  FROM authority p JOIN ancestors a ON p.authority_id = a.parent_authority_id
 )
 SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN exit_process e ON e.stage != 'COMPLETED'
 WHERE NEW.accountable_kind = 'CORE' AND e.core_id = NEW.accountable_id
 AND ((a.issuer_kind = 'PERSON' AND a.issuer_id = e.person_id)
 OR (a.subject_kind = 'PERSON' AND a.subject_id = e.person_id)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ancestor is exiting this Core'); END

 SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN exit_process e ON e.stage != 'COMPLETED'

objects.name: authority_lineage_terms_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER authority_lineage_terms_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON authority
WHEN (OLD.parent_authority_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM authority child WHERE child.parent_authority_id = OLD.authority_id))
AND (OLD.issuer_kind != NEW.issuer_kind OR OLD.issuer_id != NEW.issuer_id
 OR OLD.subject_kind != NEW.subject_kind OR OLD.subject_id != NEW.subject_id
 OR OLD.accountable_kind != NEW.accountable_kind OR OLD.accountable_id != NEW.accountable_id
 OR OLD.context_json != NEW.context_json OR OLD.scope_json != NEW.scope_json
 OR OLD.valid_from != NEW.valid_from OR OLD.valid_until IS NOT NEW.valid_until)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'delegation terms are immutable; revoke and issue a new grant'); END

  AND p.subject_kind = NEW.issuer_kind AND p.subject_id = NEW.issuer_id

statements:
CREATE TABLE action (
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision_ref  TEXT,
    context_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp     TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode          TEXT NOT NULL,
    target        TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (authority_ref) REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (decision_ref) REFERENCES decision(decision_id)
)

CREATE TABLE actor_signing_key (
        actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,

        public_key_base64 TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (actor_kind, actor_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE actor_signing_key_audit (
        audit_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        key_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        operation TEXT NOT NULL,
        public_key_base64 TEXT,
        occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE authentication_binding (
    unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_subject TEXT NOT NULL,
    person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    linked_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (unit_id, provider_id, provider_subject),
    FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
)

CREATE TABLE authority (
    authority_id     TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    issuer_kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
    issuer_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_kind     TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_json       TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json     TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_json       TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_from       TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_until      TEXT,
    accountable_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    accountable_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_authority_id TEXT REFERENCES authority(authority_id)
)

CREATE TABLE authority_revocation (
 revocation_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 authority_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
 cascade_root TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority(authority_id),
 actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE consent (
    consent_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    notice TEXT NOT NULL,
    affirmation TEXT NOT NULL,
    granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    valid_until TEXT,
    revoked_at TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (subject_person_id) REFERENCES person(person_id)
)

CREATE TABLE core (
    core_id     TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    state       TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE core_exit_relation (
 relation_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person(person_id),
 core_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core(core_id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','CLOSED')))

CREATE TABLE decision (
    decision_id   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    intent_ref    TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    chosen_option TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp     TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Execute mission action',
    affected_persons_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

)

CREATE TABLE event (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    type            TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp       TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_json    TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_ref   TEXT,
    decision_ref    TEXT,

CREATE TRIGGER authority_ancestor_exit_insert BEFORE INSERT ON authority
WHEN NEW.parent_authority_id IS NOT NULL
AND NEW.state NOT IN ('REVOKED','COMPLETED','REJECTED','ABORTED','FAILED')
AND EXISTS (
 WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(authority_id, parent_authority_id, issuer_kind, issuer_id, subject_kind, subject_id) AS (
  SELECT authority_id, parent_authority_id, issuer_kind, issuer_id, subject_kind, subject_id
  FROM authority WHERE authority_id = NEW.parent_authority_id
  UNION
  SELECT p.authority_id, p.parent_authority_id, p.issuer_kind, p.issuer_id, p.subject_kind, p.subject_id
  FROM authority p JOIN ancestors a ON p.authority_id = a.parent_authority_id
 )
 SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN exit_process e ON e.stage != 'COMPLETED'
 WHERE NEW.accountable_kind = 'CORE' AND e.core_id = NEW.accountable_id
 AND ((a.issuer_kind = 'PERSON' AND a.issuer_id = e.person_id)
 OR (a.subject_kind = 'PERSON' AND a.subject_id = e.person_id)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ancestor is exiting this Core'); END

  SELECT authority_id, parent_authority_id, issuer_kind, issuer_id, subject_kind, subject_id

  UNION
  SELECT p.authority_id, p.parent_authority_id, p.issuer_kind, p.issuer_id, p.subject_kind, p.subject_id

 )
 SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN exit_process e ON e.stage != 'COMPLETED'
 WHERE NEW.accountable_kind = 'CORE' AND e.core_id = NEW.accountable_id
 AND ((a.issuer_kind = 'PERSON' AND a.issuer_id = e.person_id)

CREATE TRIGGER membership_exit_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON membership
WHEN NEW.state = 'ACTIVE'
AND NEW.collective_kind = 'CORE'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exit_process e WHERE e.stage != 'COMPLETED'
AND e.core_id = NEW.collective_id
AND e.person_id = NEW.person_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot add live commitments during exit'); END

CREATE TRIGGER membership_exit_guard_update BEFORE UPDATE ON membership
WHEN NEW.state = 'ACTIVE'
AND NEW.collective_kind = 'CORE'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exit_process e WHERE e.stage != 'COMPLETED'
AND e.core_id = NEW.collective_id
AND e.person_id = NEW.person_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot add live commitments during exit'); END

CREATE TRIGGER typed_relation_no_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON core_exit_relation WHEN EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM relation_terms WHERE relation_id = OLD.relation_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'typed relation history is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER typed_relation_no_rewrite
BEFORE UPDATE ON core_exit_relation WHEN EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM relation_terms WHERE relation_id = OLD.relation_id)
AND (NEW.relation_id != OLD.relation_id OR NEW.person_id != OLD.person_id OR NEW.core_id != OLD.core_id
OR NEW.kind != OLD.kind OR NEW.description != OLD.description OR OLD.state = 'CLOSED')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'typed relation cannot be rewritten or reopened'); END
